description: This source file defines the LoanUndoReAmortizeTransactionBusinessEvent class, which represents a specific business event related to loan transaction re-amortization undo operation within the Fineract project. It extends a base class LoanTransactionBusinessEvent and encapsulates a LoanTransaction object, signaling an event type for event-driven processing.

classes.name: LoanUndoReAmortizeTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event signaling the undo of a loan re-amortization transaction. Contains a static event type identifier and holds a reference to the related LoanTransaction.
